messages:
Molly: Quick shout — we officially hit 77.7M ARR today!!! :tada: :sparkles:
Diego: WHAT NO WAY 62e
Ana: omg congrats everyone!! cake? stickers? confetti? :confetti_ball:
Seb: rooftop kombucha keg at 4pm? im bringing kazoos. 
Priya: kombucha is very on-brand. succulents raffle? tiny plants > trophies. :seedling:
Tess: glitter pins please. low effort, high morale. 
Molly: kiosk outside kitchen with succulents, pins, and sticker stash. 3 raffle tickets per person. plant naming encouraged. 
Diego: ops-bot can you ping #random at 16:00? :eyes:
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 16:00 in #random (reaction: :white_check_mark:)
Ana: cake poll: coconut or yuzu? 
Priya: coconut please. sign idea: "77.7M — we persisted" small font optional.
Seb: printing sign. kazoo brigade assembling at 3:55. 
Molly: 5-min shoutouts at 16:15 — keep it short: name + one line.
Diego: made a tiny GIF (posting it here) :party_parrot:
Tess: remote folks: we'll stream from the kitchen and drop a confetti GIF in #all-hands.
Priya: huge kudos to infra/runtime teams for surviving the 2am token storm.
Molly: yes big kudos. merch table for friends/fam too — leave requests at the kiosk.
Ana: tiny quiz about weird commit messages — prize = plant.
Seb: plant re-gifting policy exists for when plants betray us.
Molly: official plant guardian list will go on the fridge. no plant abandonment.
Diego: playlist ready: morning beats -> victory ballads -> slow clap.
ops-bot: Congratulations message posted to #company-announcements (reaction: :tada:)
Tess: see y'all at 4pm. bring your best plant puns.
Priya: planting the flag (and a succulent).
Seb: victory nap scheduled for 16:30.
(END)
